# UI Pirate — SaaS & AI Product Design & Development Agency

> UI Pirate is a full-service product design and development agency founded by Vishal Anand. We turn product ideas into fully functional shipped products — handling everything from product thinking and competitive analysis to UX/UI design and end-to-end software development (Angular, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, and Cloud Architecture). Serving Fortune 500 and enterprise clients across USA, UK, Singapore, India, and Australia.

## What Makes Us Different

We are NOT just a design studio that creates static screens. Our approach is simple: **have a conversation about your product — we carry the rest.** From a few lines of your vision, we help you:

- **Think through your product** — Product thinking, competitive analysis, market positioning
- **Plan the architecture** — Information architecture, user flows, database & API design
- **Design the experience** — UX research, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, interactive prototypes
- **Build the software** — Production-ready full-stack software development in Angular, React, Next.js, Node.js, and Python
- **Ship and scale** — Cloud deployment, performance optimization, design systems, component libraries

We specialize in **complex enterprise SaaS and AI applications** — the kind with multi-role dashboards, data-heavy interfaces, intricate backend workflows, API integrations, and real business logic. Not just marketing pages, but fully developed, production-grade applications.

## About

**Core Technologies**: Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, Framer, Webflow
**Founder**: Vishal Anand — 9+ years of experience in product design & full-stack software development
**Team**: Vishal Anand (Founder & Lead Designer), Danish Ansari (Lead Frontend Developer), Syed Musaddiq (Lead UX Designer), Kartik Kumar (Lead Graphics & Motion), Aniket (Lead Backend Developer)
**Headquarters**: India (serving clients globally)
**Founded**: 2015
**Projects Shipped**: 50+ products with 5.0 rating

## Services

- **SaaS & AI Web/Mobile App Design & Full-Stack Development**: End-to-end product design and full-stack engineering (Angular, React, Next.js, Node.js, Python). From raw idea to shipped product — market analysis, information architecture, UX/UI design, database architecture, API engineering, and production deployment. Timeline: 1-2 months.
- **Landing Pages & Business Websites**: High-converting marketing websites and corporate web platforms designed for maximum conversion and developed with modern Next.js/React engineering. Timeline: 2-4 weeks.
- **Full-Stack Software Engineering & UI Development**: Production-ready software development in Angular (v14+), React, Next.js, and backend API services. Specializing in data-heavy enterprise platforms, real-time analytics dashboards, AI model integrations, and performance engineering.
- **Design Systems & Component Libraries**: Custom design tokens, branded UI kits, documented and dev-ready Angular/React component libraries for scalable product teams. Timeline: 1-4 weeks.
- **Graphic Design**: Brand identity, infographics, newsletters, website graphics, social media visuals, and print-ready marketing materials.
- **Motion Graphics & Video Editing**: 2D/3D animations, social media reels/ads, explainer videos, sound design, color grading, and motion graphics for web and product.
- **UX Audits & Consultation**: Heuristic analysis, usability testing, friction point identification, and strategic UX recommendations for existing products.
- **3D Animation & Rendering**: 3D product visualization, architectural rendering, and animated 3D assets for marketing and product use.

## Our Approach

1. **Listen** — You share your vision, even if it's just a few lines of an idea
2. **Think** — We do competitive analysis, market research, product thinking
3. **Plan** — Information architecture, user flows, feature prioritization
4. **Design** — Wireframes → High-fidelity UI → Interactive prototypes
5. **Build** — Production-ready Angular/React code, API integration, testing
6. **Ship** — Deployment, documentation, handoff, and ongoing support
